request: Investigate why order ORD-1004 is late.

steps.text: I will pull the order details to see its promised delivery date, fulfillment status, items, and warehouse.
Since the order has shipped and is past its promised date, I will check the shipment tracking to confirm delay status, current location, and any carrier-reported reason.
Because the tracking has stalled since 2026-03-07 with no delay reason, I will check if Lone Star Parcel has any service alerts for Little Rock, AR that could explain it.

arguments.summary: Order ORD-1004 is overdue; the shipment has had no tracking movement since 2026-03-07 and the carrier has not provided a reason or updated ETA.
evidence: get_order_details: ORD-1004 fulfillment_status SHIPPED; promised_delivery_date 2026-03-10; is_past_promised_date true (days_until_promised_date -6).

get_shipment_status: SHP-5004 (Lone Star Parcel) tracking LSP-40417 status IN_TRANSIT; dispatch_date 2026-03-05; last_event_date 2026-03-07 at Little Rock, AR; days_since_last_event 9; current_estimated_delivery_date null; recorded_delay_reason null; is_overdue true; days_past_promised_date 6.
get_carrier_alerts: Lone Star Parcel at Little Rock, AR alert_count 0 (no active or historical alerts matching location) as of 2026-03-16.
arguments.likely_cause: Tracking has stalled at Little Rock, AR since 2026-03-07 with no carrier-reported delay and no matching service alerts.
uncertainties: Current location of the package and its revised delivery ETA are unknown.
Whether the parcel is misrouted or held at an intermediate facility is unknown.

recommended_actions.details: Contact Lone Star Parcel to initiate a trace on SHP-5004 (tracking LSP-40417); last scan 2026-03-07 at Little Rock, AR; shipment is 6 days past the promised date with no ETA or delay reason (per get_shipment_status). Request current location, cause, and a confirmed ETA.

Inform Fabrikam Foods that order ORD-1004 is delayed; last carrier scan was 2026-03-07 in Little Rock, AR and the shipment is 6 days past the 2026-03-10 promise (per get_shipment_status and get_order_details). Advise that we have requested a trace from Lone Star Parcel and will share the updated ETA once received.
Monitor tracking for SHP-5004 (LSP-40417) daily until movement resumes or an ETA is provided, given the stalled tracking and lack of carrier alerts (per get_shipment_status and get_carrier_alerts).

arguments.recommendation: Start a carrier trace with Lone Star Parcel immediately, notify the customer of the delay, and monitor tracking for updates.
